# Vendored SIFEN XSDs

Unmodified official DNIT schemas for `siRecepDE_v150`, fetched 2026-09-23 via
a manual download (the refresh tool lands in a follow-up PR) from `https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/`.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `siRecepDE_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/siRecepDE_v150.xsd |
| `DE_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/DE_v150.xsd |
| `DE_Types_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/DE_Types_v150.xsd |
| `Paises_v100.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Paises_v100.xsd |
| `Departamentos_v141.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Departamentos_v141.xsd |
| `Monedas_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Monedas_v150.xsd |
| `Unidades_Medida_v141.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Unidades_Medida_v141.xsd |
| `xmldsig-core-schema.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/xmldsig-core-schema.xsd |

`checksums.json` is the authoritative file list, generated by the same command.
`verify-vendor` fails the build if any vendored byte changes.
